He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Princeton Tigers men's basketball|Princeton Tigers]]. ==Early life== Evbuomwan was born and raised in [[Newcastle upon Tyne|Newcastle upon Tyne, England]].{{cite web |last=Spears |first=Marc J. |title=Princeton's Tosan Evbuomwan has 'come a long way' to the Sweet 16 |url=https://andscape.com/features/princetons-tosan-evbuomwan-has-come-a-long-way-to-the-sweet-16/ |website=Andscape |access-date=2 February 2024 |date=23 March 2023}} His father, Isaac, is a gynecologist who played college basketball at the [[University of Lagos]] in his native Nigeria. His mother, Michelle, who was born to a Nigerian father and Irish mother, moved to [[Lagos]] when she was 21 years old. Using her commercial pilot's license she earned in the UK, she became the first female captain to pilot a plane in Nigeria. Michelle met Isaac when she went in for a physical and they began dating. Isaac moved to England for work one year later and Michelle followed him there; they decided to settle in Newcastle after starting a family. Evbuomwan's mother died of breast cancer on 16 November 2012.{{cite news |last=Armstrong |first=Kevin |title=The most interesting man in March Madness is drawing NBA scouts to N.J. |url=https://www.nj.com/sports/2022/03/the-most-interesting-man-in-march-madness-is-drawing-nba-scouts-to-nj.html |access-date=16 March 2022 |date=11 March 2022}} Evbuomwan grew up playing football, rugby, cricket and track & field, and was a standout football star, being selected to [[Newcastle United]]'s Youth Academy. He had a basketball hoop at his house because his father had played in Nigeria, but he did not begin playing basketball competitively until age 14. Evbuomwan attended [[Royal Grammar School, Newcastle upon Tyne]] and helped start the basketball team there with a friend. He subsequently played for the [[Newcastle Eagles]] U18 team and took part in the Deng Camp run by [[Luol Deng]], in which his play began receiving more attention.{{cite web |title=Journey To Jadwin - Tosan Evbuomwan |url=https://goprincetontigers.com/news/2020/6/18/mens-basketball-journey-to-jadwin-tosan-evbuomwan.aspx |website=[[Princeton Tigers]] |access-date=16 March 2022 |date=18 June 2020}} Eagles head coach [[Ian MacLeod (basketball)|Ian MacLeod]] sent highlight clips of the star player to American universities, and [[Princeton Tigers men's basketball|Princeton]] assistant coach Brett MacConnell was impressed, and suggested to head coach [[Mitch Henderson]] to recruit him.{{cite news |last=Kelly |first=Mike |title=Former Newcastle Royal Grammar School pupil wins top US college basketball award |url=https://www.chroniclelive.co.uk/news/north-east-news/newcastle-tosan-evbuomwan-princeton-tigers-23384320 |access-date=16 March 2022 |work=[[Evening Chronicle]] |date=14 March 2022}} Evbuomwan signed with Princeton in April 2019.{{cite web |last=King |first=Jeff |title=THE TOSAN REPORT: PART 1 |url=https://newcastle-eagles.com/news/the-tosan-report-part-1/ |website=[[Newcastle Eagles]] |access-date=16 March 2022 |date=24 December 2019}} ==College career== Evbuomwan averaged 3.9 points, 1.8 rebounds and 0.9 assists per game as a freshman at Princeton, making 19 starts. The 2020–21 season was cancelled in the [[Ivy League]] due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite news |last=Feil |first=Justin |date=March 2022 |title=Men's Basketball: The Star Forward from Newcastle |url=https://paw.princeton.edu/article/mens-basketball-star-forward-newcastle |access-date=16 March 2022 |work=Princeton Alumni Weekly}} He practiced against the Newcastle Eagles during the pandemic and joined Great Britain's 3x3 team in Tel Aviv. On 4 December 2021, Evbuomwan scored a career-high 27 points in an 81–79 overtime win against [[2021–22 Drexel Dragons men's basketball team|Drexel]].{{cite news |date=4 December 2021 |title=Evbuomwan lifts Princeton over Drexel 81-79 in OT |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401372199 |access-date=16 March 2022 |work=[[ESPN]]|agency=Automated Insights}} He matched his career high of 27 points as well as seven rebounds and five steals on 4 February 2022, in an 88–83 loss to [[2021–22 Cornell Big Red men's basketball team|Cornell]].{{cite news |date=4 February 2022 |title=Manon scores 22 to lift Cornell past Princeton 88-83 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401369752 |access-date=16 March 2022 |work=[[ESPN]]|agency=Automated Insights}} As a junior, Evbuomwan was named unanimous [[Ivy League Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Ivy League Player of the Year]].{{cite press release |title=Ivy League Announces Men's Basketball Major Awards and All-Ivy Teams |date=8 March 2022 |publisher=[[Ivy League]] |url=https://ivyleague.com/news/2022/3/8/ivy-league-announces-mens-basketball-major-awards-and-all-ivy-teams.aspx |access-date=16 March 2022 |website=IvyLeague.com}} In 2023, Evbuomwan was named First Team All-Ivy League{{cite web|title=Princeton men's basketball Tosan Evbuomwan named First Team All-Ivy; Caden Pierce voted Rookie of the Year|url=https://www.trentonian.com/2023/03/07/princeton-mens-basketball-tosan-evbuomwan-named-first-team-all-ivy-caden-pierce-voted-rookie-of-the-year|website=Trentonian.com|date=7 March 2023|access-date=18 March 2023|last=Franko|first=Kyle}} and First Team All-District.{{cite web |date=13 March 2023 |title=NABC Names Tosan Evbuomwan First Team All-District |url=https://goprincetontigers.com/news/2023/3/13/mens-basketball-nabc-names-tosan-evbuomwan-first-team-all-district.aspx |access-date=18 March 2023 |work=Princeton University Athletics}} On 30 March 2023, he declared for the [[2023 NBA draft]].{{cite web |title=Tosan Evbuomwan Declares For NBA Draft |url=https://goprincetontigers.com/news/2023/3/30/mens-basketball-tosan-evbuomwan-declares-for-nba-draft |website=[[Princeton Tigers]] |access-date=13 April 2026 |date=30 March 2023}} ==Professional |date=30 January 2024 |title=Grizzlies sign Tosan Evbuomwan and Trey Jemison to 10-day contracts (including 7 offensive rebounds) in a 131–91 blowout loss to the [[Boston Celtics]].{{cite web |date=4 February 2024 |title=Memphis Grizzlies at Boston Celtics Box Score, February 4, 2024 contract with the [[Detroit Pistons]]{{cite tweet |number=1757448329095786539 |user=Pistons_PR |title=The Detroit Pistons announced today that the team has signed forward Tosan Evbuomwan to a 10-Day contract. |author=Pistons PR |date=13 February 2024 |access-date=13 February 2024}} and on 23 February 2024, he signed a [[two-way contract]] with the Pistons.{{cite tweet|author=Pistons PR|title=The @DetroitPistons announced today that the team has signed Stanley Umude to a contract and signed guard Buddy Boeheim and forward Tosan Evbuomwan to two-way contracts.|number=1761074632289890744|user=Pistons_PR|date=23 February 2024|access-date=23 February 2024}} On 16 October 2024, he was waived by the Pistons.{{cite tweet |number=1846675900143632678
